issues.description: Method name mismatch for the Grover-assembly routine in Exercise 1: the template defines a method named build_grover(qc, query_register) but the class run() in the same template calls self.grover_circuit(...). The provided solution implements grover_circuit(...). This inconsistent naming (build_grover vs grover_circuit) means a student using the template will encounter an undefined method (AttributeError) when running run(), and tests or instructor expectations that refer to grover_circuit will not match the starter code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the starter template use the same method name as the tests and solution. Rename the template method build_grover(...) to grover_circuit(...) (and update its docstring/task label) so run() and the problem/test expectations match. Alternatively, change run() to call build_grover(...) and update the solution/tests to the chosen name — prefer renaming build_grover to grover_circuit to align with the solution and exercise task names.
